paper.title: Evolving Medical Imaging Agents via Experience-driven Self-skill Discovery
paper.central_claim: MACRO 从经验证医疗影像执行轨迹持续发现并注册组合工具，结合图像记忆和GRPO提升多步编排及跨域泛化。

provenance.notes: 按当前调用配置执行 sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol；无独立后端回执与会话凭据，不探测模型。

sections_read: 全部末尾；正文无独立附录

evidence.quote: Similarly, EvolveR distills an agent’s past interaction trajectories into a repository of abstract strategic principles and then updates the agent (via reinforcement learning) to use those principles on new tasks
evidence.support_explanation: 谱系来自作者对 EvolveR 的描述，未独立核邻居全文。

evidence.quote: retrieved entries into the prompt as in-context demonstrations.
evidence.support_explanation: 图像特征检索的病例作为上下文。

evidence.quote: is registered as a composite tool when its frequency exceeds a threshold
evidence.support_explanation: 成功轨迹的频繁连续子串注册为工具；不是测量边际效用的保留门控。

evidence.quote: This delayed success signal provides a global credit assignment and enables the discovery of new composite patterns, but it does not directly affect the policy gradient updates in Stage 2.
evidence.support_explanation: 正确性用于更新库，但 RL 直接奖励组合调用，不能等同准确性奖励。

evidence.quote: All other hyperparameters (learning rate, LoRA, training epochs etc.) are kept identical across conditions.
evidence.support_explanation: 递增消融声称同超参；结果需同时考虑训练与工具库变化。
组合加入后 REFUGE2 BACC 90.6，对比仅记忆83.9；MITEA 75.1 对72.4。

evidence.quote: while BACC shows a marginal decrease of 0.6% on heart disease, F1 score improves by a notable 2.6%
evidence.support_explanation: 优于所有方法并非全部指标成立。

evidence.quote: First, composite quality is fundamentally bounded by trajectory verification fidelity; noisy or partially correct traces risk introducing suboptimal skills into the library.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认整轨迹正确不保证每个步骤正确。

evidence.quote: After each training episode, if the final prediction is correct
evidence.support_explanation: 标注训练样本真值决定写库，不能直接外推无标签部署。

evidence.quote: we apply LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) with rank
evidence.support_explanation: 权重与非权重同时更新，但非权重库有直接消融，按 A3 在范围内。
